blogs.title: The Second-Trimester Trap: Navigating Diagnostic Ambiguity Between Endometriomas and Degenerating Leiomyomas
blogs.description: This post explores the diagnostic dilemma presented by complex abdominal masses in pregnancy. We will dissect why the classic 'decidualized endometrioma' mimicry occurs, analyze the utility of non-contrast MRI versus ultrasound in distinguishing between ovarian pathology and pedunculated leiomyomas with red degeneration, and discuss the pitfalls of relying solely on tumor markers like CA-125 during gestation.

blogs.title: When to Cut? Decision-Making Algorithms for Symptomatic Pelvic Masses in Pregnancy
blogs.description: Focusing on the tension between expectant management and surgical intervention, this article analyzes the specific indications that tipped the scale in this case (torsion risk, compressive dyspnea, diagnostic uncertainty). We will review current literature on timing (second vs. third trimester), the risks of preterm labor, and when 'doing nothing' becomes a dangerous liability.

blogs.title: Surgical Strategy in Gravid Myomectomy: The Art of Partial Resection and Fetal Preservation
blogs.description: A technical deep-dive into the intraoperative decisions made in this case. Why was the caudal mass intentionally left alone while the cranial mass was resected? We will discuss surgical principles for minimizing uterine trauma, managing hemorrhage in a hypervascular gravid uterus, and strategies to prevent iatrogenic uterine rupture or preterm contractions during myomectomy.

blogs.title: Beyond the Ultrasound: Interpreting Elevated CA-125 in a Pregnant Patient
blogs.description: While CA-125 is a standard oncologic marker, its interpretation shifts dramatically during pregnancy due to physiological fluctuations. This post breaks down the bimodal nature of CA-125 rises (first and third trimester peaks) versus pathological elevations, using this case's rising trend as a teaching tool for differentiating benign degenerative processes from malignancy without unnecessary alarm.
